'''2000 Florida State Championship Walter Cowart Florida State Champs LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Walter Cowart]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Florida State Championship]]. The post (2 April 2000) says: 'This is a Throne Room mains deck thatI used to win the Florida State Championsihp.' The title is 'Florida State Champs LS'.<ref name="dt-5008">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5008 Florida State Champs LS], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 2 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5008/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5008/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018185832/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5008/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Florida State Champs LS'''
* '''Author:''' Walter "Walter" Cowart
* '''Published:''' April 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a Throne Room mains deck thatI used to win the Florida State Championsihp.

=== Strategy ===

This is a basic Throne Room Mains deck with some personal taste that works very well against most decks. I'll refrain from a long strategy that has already been written and just point out some key cards that really help H'nemtheGetting this guy early against decks w/lots of Imperials really hurts them. Tunnel Visionfor speed Bith Shuffle,Shocks etc.I can track them good. Old Obi and StickBetter drains and staying power RedemptionCheaper mains w/the Bacta Tank

Just remember that you have to know how you are gonna win pretty early to have an advantage

This may look all too familiar but I don't care. It works very well in the environment around me and I think I proved that. Thank you for your time.

Walter Cowart
